title: Granola logo wall
description: A window-wide serif headline on white sitting on top of a charcoal band, which holds a small serif title and a quiet wall of customer names: three per row on phones, a 6×2 grid with faint + marks at the joins on desktop. As the section scrolls away the headline slides down beneath the band; the title gets a pastel shimmer that sweeps through it as it rises into view.
notes: the band carries the dark class itself (charcoal under the light theme); the headline band follows the page
names are plain text in sans, serif or mono for variety; 12 names fill both layouts
headline is sized to the window width (12.3vw / 11.3vw) and stays on one line; keep it short
CSS view timelines; with reduced motion or without support the headline stays put and the title is plain
